findings.message: The first raw data block that is read to its end holds none, which decides the stream as plain as FFmpeg 6.1.1 does, but 9 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data; the first block that disagrees is raw data block 2.

ADTS signals no SBR, and the first raw data block that is read to its end and not in a damaged frame holds none, which decides the stream as plain AAC LC as FFmpeg 6.1.1 does, so the report shows the core alone; 9 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data after a channel element.
